# MISP

## Summary

Learn how to use the MISP node in n8n.

**Source**: https://docs.n8n.io/integrations/builtin/app-nodes/n8n-nodes-base.misp.md

---

Learn how to use the MISP node in n8n. Follow technical documentation to integrate MISP node into your workflows.

Use the MISP node to automate work in MISP, and integrate MISP with other applications. n8n has built-in support for a wide range of MISP features, including creating, updating, deleting and getting events, feeds, and organizations.

On this page, you'll find a list of operations the MISP node supports and links to more resources.

{% hint style="info" %}
**Credentials**

Refer to [MISP credentials](/integrations/builtin/credentials/misp) for guidance on setting up authentication.
{% endhint %}

### What to do if your operation isn't supported <a href="#what-to-do-if-your-operation-isnt-supported" id="what-to-do-if-your-operation-isnt-supported"></a>

If this node doesn't support the operation you want to do, you can use the [HTTP Request node](/integrations/builtin/core-nodes/n8n-nodes-base.httprequest) to call the service's API.

You can use the credential you created for this service in the HTTP Request node:

1. In the HTTP Request node, select **Authentication** > **Predefined Credential Type**.
2. Select the service you want to connect to.
3. Select your credential.

Refer to [Custom API operations](/integrations/builtin/custom-api-actions-for-existing-nodes) for more information.
